properties.reviewNotes: UPC documents 75 MW and 30 turbines, grid supply from March 2018 and construction completion on 5 April 2018. A September 2017 ESDM report targeted early 2018 operation. Twenty-seven GRW points align with distinct mapped turbine positions; the saved extract is a partial footprint, not measured capacity or a schedule verdict.

claimSources.supports: UPC reports 75 MW, 30 turbines, grid supply from March 2018 and construction completion on 5 April 2018. These dates represent different milestones.
75 MW, 30 turbines and a planned early-2018 commercial operating date; early 2018 retained at quarter precision.

properties.reviewNotes: PUB documents operation of the 60 MWp commercial farm in July 2021, distinct from the earlier 1 MWp testbed. Three 2021 GRW polygons have reviewed attribution to the commercial site; this is a partial footprint, not a capacity measurement. The registry point is the centroid of the approximate community-mapped commercial boundary.

claimSources.supports: PUB reports opening and commencement of operations on 14 July 2021 at 60 MWp. This is documentary operating evidence, not a satellite capacity measurement.
Distinguishes the 2016 1 MWp testbed from the later 60 MWp commercial farm and its ten floating islands.
